text: Photography is an art of capturing moments in time through the lens of a camera. Lighting is crucial in photography as it can dramatically affect the mood and aesthetic of a scene. Proper lighting can highlight the beauty of a subject, while poor lighting can make it appear dull and uninteresting. To achieve the perfect light, photographers often use diffusers or reflectors to soften harsh shadows and enhance the highlights. Once the right lighting is captured, a tripod can help maintain a steady and stable shot, even in low-light conditions. This allows for sharper images with reduced blur and increased depth of field.
